title: Review reusable Help authoring, embedding, citations and dogfooding
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

Cross-cutting acceptance review: verify Help is conventionally discoverable; structured Markus docs are authored/edited through the agreed Papyrus lifecycle; consumers use one exported dependency with product themes; chat remains optional; retrieval/citations respect the correct publication/knowledge base and existing reader permissions. Review navigation, stable links, draft exclusion, source revision/freshness, inaccessible citations and unsupported-answer behavior. Reconcile Chatticus reuse matrix and existing migration evidence, representative consumer walkthroughs, ownership/package decisions and evidence from the independent backend investigation. Record actual verification versus unimplemented acceptance; never mark all documentation current merely because files exist.
